title: Implementing Agile at the Enterprise Level

stages.title: Moving Fast in a Giant Machine

parts.visual:
Startups are naturally fast (Agile). Massive corporations are naturally slow (Waterfall). Executive leadership must figure out how to make a 10,000-person company move like a startup.

The Agile Pillars:
1. Sprints: Breaking massive 2-year projects into 2-week executable chunks.
2. Cross-Functional Teams: Putting a developer, marketer, and lawyer in the same room to eliminate hand-off delays.
3. The MVP: Launching the 'Minimum Viable Product' to test the market, rather than waiting for perfection.
parts.audio: To make a massive corporation move fast, executives implement Agile methodologies. Use short Sprints, build Cross-Functional Teams, and launch Minimum Viable Products.

questions.question: What is the primary flaw of the traditional 'Waterfall' project management method for modern software?
options: You spend two years building something in secret, only to launch it and realize the market no longer wants it.
questions.correct_answer: You spend two years building something in secret, only to launch it and realize the market no longer wants it.
questions.explanation: Waterfall assumes requirements never change. Agile assumes the market changes every month.

questions.question: Listen to the Product Director. What Agile concept is being deployed?
questions.tts_text: We are not building the full 3D app yet. Just build a basic webpage with a 'Buy' button to see if anyone actually clicks it.
options: Building the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) to test assumptions quickly.
questions.correct_answer: Building the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) to test assumptions quickly.
questions.explanation: Why spend $1M building a feature if you can spend $1k to prove nobody wants it?

questions.question: Why do 'Cross-Functional Teams' drastically speed up enterprise projects?
options: They destroy 'Silos'. Instead of Engineering taking 3 weeks to email Legal for approval, the lawyer is on the team and approves it instantly.
questions.correct_answer: They destroy 'Silos'. Instead of Engineering taking 3 weeks to email Legal for approval, the lawyer is on the team and approves it instantly.
questions.explanation: Corporate slowness is mostly caused by waiting for other departments to reply. Agile merges the departments.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a 'Scrum' or 'Daily Stand-up' meeting?
options: To talk for 2 hours about weekend plans.
A strict 15-minute meeting where the team simply states: What they did yesterday, what they will do today, and what is blocking them.
questions.correct_answer: A strict 15-minute meeting where the team simply states: What they did yesterday, what they will do today, and what is blocking them.
questions.explanation: It is not a status report for the boss; it is an alignment tool for the team to remove blockers instantly.
